name: Saga Pattern (Choreography Topology)
forces_resolved: No centralized single point of coordination or bottleneck
Services independently react to domain events published by peers
Natural fit for event-driven event stream topologies
forces_unresolved: Difficult to understand overall end-to-end transaction flow by reading code
Risk of cyclic event dependency loops
Integration testing requires spinning up all participating event consumers
applicability_conditions: Simple workflows involving 2 to 4 collaborating services
Teams already heavily utilizing an asynchronous broker (Kafka/RabbitMQ)
Workflows where autonomy of individual services takes priority over central control
anti_requisites: Complex workflows involving 5+ participating services (choreography becomes unmanageable)
Strict regulatory compliance requiring an auditable centralized transaction state machine
Teams lacking comprehensive distributed tracing infrastructure
